Recommendation (Phase A, 0–90 days): run a focused validation sprint that prioritizes six initiatives—(1) selective merchant & consumer price lifts A/B tested on high‑ARPU cohorts, (2) rapid wallet partner integration with revenue‑share pilots, (3) targeted paid acquisition for segments with <12‑month CAC payback, (4) immediate tightening of unsecured/BNPL origination rules and pause on co‑marketing to high‑risk channels, (5) deploy advanced early‑warning scoring + intensified collections analytics, and (6) fund via 5–7% immediate non‑staff cost takeouts and a freeze/slowdown of low‑ROI projects.
